title: Lecture 11 daily quiz
instructions: Answer all 28 questions from Lecture 11. Each question carries one mark. You may resubmit before the deadline.

questions.explanation: Differentiate term by term to obtain 12x² − 10x + 2.
Using (AB)′ = AB′ + BA′ gives tan x/x + logₑx · sec²x.

questions.prompt: If y = A/x³ − B/x⁴, find x for which dy/dx = 0.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = −3Ax⁻⁴ + 4Bx⁻⁵. Setting it to zero gives x = 4B/(3A).
The quotient rule gives [x²eˣ − 2xeˣ]/x⁴ = eˣ(x − 2)/x³.
The quotient-rule numerator simplifies to 4x, giving 4x/(x² + 1)².

questions.prompt: Differentiate y = cos x + 2/x³, where x ≠ 0.
questions.explanation: Write 2/x³ as 2x⁻³. Therefore dy/dx = −sin x − 6/x⁴.
Expand first: y = x + 2 + 1/x. Hence dy/dx = 1 − 1/x².

questions.prompt: For y = x³ − 5x + x², find dy/dx at x = 1.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 3x² − 5 + 2x. At x = 1 this is 3 − 5 + 2 = 0.

questions.prompt: For y = 4x³ + 3sin x − 4eˣ, which set gives the first four derivatives correctly?
questions.explanation: Differentiate repeatedly; the exponential remains eˣ and the sine/cosine derivatives cycle.
Successive derivatives give d³y/dx³ = 60x² + 48x + 18 and d⁴y/dx⁴ = 120x + 48.
Outer derivative is cosine and the inner derivative is 6x².
For eᵘ, multiply eᵘ by du/dx. Here u = x², so du/dx = 2x.
The derivative of the inner function sin x is cos x.
Differentiate the outer cube, then multiply by the inner derivative 2x + 2.
The outer derivative is 5(2x+3)⁴ and the inner derivative is 2.
dy/dx = cos x/sin x = cot x.
Differentiate sine, then multiply by d(logₑx)/dx = 1/x.
Write y = (x+4)¹ᐟ² and apply the power rule.
Treat y as (sin x)². Its derivative is 2sin x cos x = sin 2x.
Apply the chain rule twice: exponential, sine, then x³.
Differentiate one variable at a time while holding the other two constant.

questions.prompt: If y = 2t³ + 1 and x = t², find dy/dx.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = (dy/dt)/(dx/dt) = 6t²/(2t) = 3t for t ≠ 0.

questions.prompt: If y = sin u and u = 3x, find dx/dy.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 3cos(3x), so dx/dy is its reciprocal.

questions.prompt: Find the slope of y = 3x² + 5x − 4 at x = 1.
questions.explanation: dy/dx = 6x + 5. At x = 1, the slope is 11.

questions.prompt: Differentiate y = A cos(kx), where A and k are constants.
questions.explanation: Differentiate cosine and multiply by the inner derivative k.
The constant 5 remains outside and d(e³ˣ)/dx = 3e³ˣ.
The inner derivative of −x is −1, so dy/dx = −e⁻ˣ.
Keep 3 outside, differentiate sine, and multiply by d(x²+2)/dx = 2x.
